modules.name: assets-manager-web
modules.description: Web module for assets manager that handles file uploads and viewing

modules.name: assets-manager-worker
modules.description: Worker module for assets manager that handles thumbnail generation

incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK Usage in Web Module
incidents.description: Application uses AWS S3 SDK (software.amazon.awssdk:s3) for cloud storage in the web module. This needs to be migrated to Azure Blob Storage.
incidents.recommendation: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob). Update AwsS3Service to use Azure Blob Storage client.

incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK Usage in Worker Module
incidents.description: Application uses AWS S3 SDK (software.amazon.awssdk:s3) for cloud storage in the worker module. This needs to be migrated to Azure Blob Storage.
incidents.recommendation: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob). Update S3FileProcessingService to use Azure Blob Storage client.

incidents.title: AWS S3 Service Implementation
incidents.description: AwsS3Service class in web module uses AWS S3Client directly for file operations. Needs migration to Azure Blob Storage.
incidents.recommendation: Refactor AwsS3Service to AzureBlobStorageService using BlobServiceClient and BlobContainerClient.

incidents.title: AWS S3 Configuration Class
incidents.description: AwsS3Config class configures AWS S3Client with access keys and region. Needs to be replaced with Azure Blob Storage configuration.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob Storage configuration using BlobServiceClientBuilder and DefaultAzureCredential for authentication.

incidents.title: AWS S3 File Processing Service
incidents.description: S3FileProcessingService in worker module uses AWS S3Client for thumbnail generation and storage.
incidents.recommendation: Refactor to use Azure Blob Storage client for file operations in worker module.

incidents.title: AWS S3 Configuration in Worker
incidents.description: Worker module has its own AwsS3Config for S3Client configuration.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob Storage configuration using DefaultAzureCredential.

incidents.title: S3StorageItem Model
incidents.description: S3StorageItem model is AWS-specific and needs to be renamed/refactored for Azure.
incidents.recommendation: Rename to BlobStorageItem or StorageItem to be cloud-agnostic.

incidents.title: S3 Controller Endpoints
incidents.description: S3Controller uses AWS-specific naming and needs to be updated for Azure.
incidents.recommendation: Rename controller and update endpoints to be cloud-agnostic (e.g., StorageController).

incidents.title: AWS Configuration Properties in Web
incidents.description: Application properties contain AWS-specific configuration (aws.accessKey, aws.secretKey, aws.region, aws.s3.bucket) in web module.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure-specific properties (azure.storage.account-name, azure.storage.container-name). Use Managed Identity instead of access keys.

incidents.title: AWS Configuration Properties in Worker
incidents.description: Application properties contain AWS-specific configuration in worker module.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure-specific properties. Use Managed Identity for authentication.

incidents.title: Static AWS Credentials Provider
incidents.description: AwsS3Config uses StaticCredentialsProvider with AwsBasicCredentials, which is not recommended for production.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Managed Identity using DefaultAzureCredential for secure, credential-less authentication.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ AMQP Dependency in Web
incidents.description: Application uses spring-boot-starter-amqp (RabbitMQ) for messaging in web module. Needs migration to Azure Service Bus.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus (com.azure.spring:spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus). Update configuration and message handling code.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ AMQP Dependency in Worker
incidents.description: Application uses spring-boot-starter-amqp (RabbitMQ) for messaging in worker module. Needs migration to Azure Service Bus.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus. Update message listener configuration.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Configuration Class
incidents.description: RabbitConfig class in web module configures RabbitMQ queues and connection factory.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus configuration. Use ServiceBusClientBuilder and configure queue processor.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Configuration in Worker
incidents.description: Worker module has RabbitMQ configuration for message consumption.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus message receiver configuration.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Connection Properties in Web
incidents.description: Application properties contain RabbitMQ connection configuration (host, port, username, password).
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus connection string or use DefaultAzureCredential with fully qualified namespace.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Connection Properties in Worker
incidents.description: Worker module contains RabbitMQ connection configuration.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus configuration.

incidents.title: Manual Acknowledge Mode
incidents.description: RabbitConfig uses manual acknowledge mode for message processing.
incidents.recommendation: Update to use Azure Service Bus message settlement modes (complete/abandon).

incidents.title: Message Converter Configuration
incidents.description: Uses Jackson2JsonMessageConverter for RabbitMQ messages.
incidents.recommendation: Azure Service Bus supports JSON natively. Update message serialization to use Service Bus message format.

incidents.title: BackupMessageProcessor
incidents.description: BackupMessageProcessor service likely uses RabbitMQ annotations or interfaces.
incidents.recommendation: Update to use Azure Service Bus @ServiceBusListener or ServiceBusProcessorClient.

incidents.title: Hardcoded AWS Access Key
incidents.description: AWS access key is hardcoded in application.properties with placeholder value 'your-access-key'.
incidents.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials. Use Azure Managed Identity with DefaultAzureCredential for authentication.

incidents.title: Hardcoded AWS Secret Key
incidents.description: AWS secret key is hardcoded in application.properties with placeholder value 'your-secret-key'.
incidents.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials. Use Azure Managed Identity for secure authentication.

incidents.title: Hardcoded Database Password
incidents.description: PostgreSQL database password is hardcoded in application.properties.
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Key Vault or Managed Identity for database authentication. For Azure Database for PostgreSQL, use managed identity.

incidents.title: Hardcoded RabbitMQ Password
incidents.description: RabbitMQ password is hardcoded in application.properties.
incidents.recommendation: When migrating to Azure Service Bus, use Managed Identity to eliminate password-based authentication.

incidents.title: PostgreSQL JDBC URL
incidents.description: Application uses local PostgreSQL database with JDBC connection string.
incidents.recommendation: Update to use Azure Database for PostgreSQL connection string. Enable SSL and use managed identity for authentication.

incidents.title: JPA DDL Auto Update
incidents.description: Application uses 'spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update' which is not recommended for production.
incidents.recommendation: Use database migration tools like Flyway or Liquibase for production schema management.

incidents.title: Spring Boot Version
incidents.description: Application uses Spring Boot 3.2.1 which may not be the latest LTS version.
incidents.recommendation: Consider upgrading to the latest Spring Boot 3.x LTS version for better security and performance.

incidents.title: Missing Application Insights
incidents.description: Application does not have Azure Application Insights integration for monitoring and telemetry.
incidents.recommendation: Add Azure Application Insights dependency and configuration for production monitoring.

incidents.title: SQL Logging Enabled
incidents.description: SQL logging is enabled with 'spring.jpa.show-sql=true' which may impact performance.
incidents.recommendation: Disable SQL logging in production or use proper logging framework with appropriate log levels.

incidents.title: Missing Profile-Specific Configuration
incidents.description: Application lacks separate configuration for dev, staging, and production environments.
incidents.recommendation: Create profile-specific properties files (application-dev.properties, application-prod.properties) for environment-specific configuration.

incidents.title: Multi-Module Application Structure
incidents.description: Application has two separate modules (web and worker) that need to be deployed independently.
incidents.recommendation: Plan for deploying web module to Azure App Service and worker module to Azure Container Apps or separate App Service instance.

incidents.title: Async Processing Pattern
incidents.description: Application uses message queue for asynchronous image processing between web and worker modules.
incidents.recommendation: This pattern works well with Azure Service Bus. Ensure message TTL and retry policies are configured appropriately.

incidents.title: Local File Storage Implementation
incidents.description: Application has LocalFileStorageService for development/testing that should be preserved.
incidents.recommendation: Keep local storage service for dev profile but ensure production always uses Azure Blob Storage.

recommendations.title: Migrate to Azure Managed Identity
recommendations.description: Replace all credential-based authentication (AWS keys, database passwords) with Azure Managed Identity. This eliminates the need to manage credentials and improves security.
benefits: Enhanced security by eliminating credential management
Compliance with Azure security best practices

recommendations.title: Migrate from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus
recommendations.description: Replace RabbitMQ with Azure Service Bus for message queuing between web and worker modules. Update configuration and message handling code.
benefits: Built-in retry and dead-letter queue support

recommendations.title: Migrate from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage (Web Module)
recommendations.description: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK in the web module. Update all file operations, configuration, and service classes.

recommendations.title: Migrate from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage (Worker Module)
recommendations.description: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK in the worker module for thumbnail storage and retrieval.

recommendations.title: Migrate to Azure Database for PostgreSQL
recommendations.description: Update database configuration to use Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server with SSL and Managed Identity authentication.

recommendations.title: Add Azure Application Insights
recommendations.description: Integrate Azure Application Insights for application monitoring, logging, and telemetry.

tasks.title: Migrate Web Module to Azure Blob Storage
Migrate Worker Module to Azure Blob Storage
Update Spring Boot and Final Optimizations

notes: This assessment was performed through manual code analysis as AppCAT MCP tools are not currently configured.
The application is well-structured with clear separation between web and worker modules.
LocalFileStorageService should be preserved for development/testing purposes.
Consider implementing health checks for both modules before deployment to Azure.
The multi-module structure allows for independent deployment and scaling of web and worker components.
Total estimated effort: 18 story points across 3 phases (3-4 weeks total).
Cloud readiness score of 62/100 indicates moderate migration complexity, primarily due to AWS services replacement.
